management
07/16/2025
Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel in the Microsoft Defender portal, Microsoft Defender
for Endpoint Plan 2, Microsoft Defender for Office 365 P2
Multitenant management for Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel in the Defender
portal provides your security operations teams with a single, unified view of all the tenants you
manage. This view enables your teams to quickly investigate incidents and perform advanced
hunting across data from multiple tenants, improving your security operations.
For each tenant, the Defender portal allows you to connect to one primary workspace and
multiple secondary workspaces for Microsoft Sentinel. In the context of this article, a workspace
is a Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled.
If you have tenants with Microsoft Sentinel workspaces onboarded to the Defender portal,
you're able to:
Triage incidents and alerts across Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and
eXtended Detection and Response (XDR) data.
Proactively search for SIEM and XDR data across multiple tenants.
Manage cases across multiple tenants.
Each workspace must be onboarded to the Defender portal for each of your tenants separately,
as you would in a single-tenant scenario.
For more information, see:
Connect Microsoft Sentinel to Microsoft Defender XDR
Multitenant organizations documentation
Multiple Microsoft Sentinel workspaces in the Defender portal
